metaData.originalTitle: 刚刚，Seedance 2.5 正式发布，国产视频模型再次捅破天花板
metaData.title: Just Now: Seedance 2.5 Officially Released, Domestic Video Model Breaks the Ceiling Again
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: This article reports on the 2026 Volcano Engine FORCE Original Power Conference, releasing models such as Doubao 2.1 Pro and Seedance 2.5, showcasing comprehensive breakthroughs in coding, video, image, and audio capabilities, and that large models have entered the core production workflow.
metaData.summary: The article covers the releases at the 2026 Volcano Engine FORCE Original Power Conference. Key highlights include the Doubao large model 2.1 Pro, which achieves top global tier in coding and Agent capabilities, with a cost of only 6 yuan per million token input, significantly reducing expenses; the Seedance 2.5 video model supports up to 30-second generation, joint input of 50 full-modality materials, and local video editing, breaking through mainstream model bottlenecks; the Seedream 5.0 Pro image model offers interactive precise editing and multi-layer separation; and the Seed-Audio 1.0 enables direct cinematic-quality sound effects generation. The article also notes that Doubao's daily token call volume reaches 180 trillion, with a 49.5% market share. Enterprises have deeply integrated large models into core processes, and Volcano Engine is transforming internal capabilities into cloud services delivered to customers.

mainPoints.point: Doubao 2.1 Pro is a flagship model that breaks through the production quality inflection point, with globally leading coding and Agent capabilities.
mainPoints.explanation: It matches or surpasses Claude Opus 4.7 on benchmarks such as Terminal Bench and SciCode, and costs only 6 yuan per million token input, significantly reducing costs.

mainPoints.point: The Seedance 2.5 video model achieves 30-second generation length, joint input of 50 full-modality materials, and local video editing, leading the world.
mainPoints.explanation: Compared to the mainstream 15-20 second limitation, this model supports more coherent shot expression and can collaborate with image models to produce high-quality science education videos.

mainPoints.point: Volcano Engine transforms ByteDance's internal model capabilities into cloud services, with enterprises deeply using large models in core processes.
mainPoints.explanation: Daily token call volume reaches 180 trillion, market share is 49.5%, tokens have become a basic consumable, and models continuously evolve through feedback.

keyQuotes: Tokens have gradually become a basic consumable like water and electricity.
When a video model crosses the production quality inflection point, its accumulated understanding of the physical world becomes an important foundation for the world model.
The peak is still ahead, but the path is clear.

relatedArticles.title: MiniMax M3: Cutting-edge Coding, 1M Context, Native Multimodal — All in One Model
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: MiniMax releases the M3 model, integrating cutting-edge coding capabilities, 1M ultra-long context, and native multimodality, making it the first domestic model to combine these features, and it has been open-sourced.

relatedArticles.title: DeepSeek Suddenly Releases DSpark, Ending AI's Toothpaste-Squeezing Generation
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: DeepSeek and Peking University jointly released the DSpark inference acceleration framework, which uses a semi-autoregressive draft model and confidence-based scheduling verification to increase online single-user generation speed by 57%-85%.

relatedArticles.title: WeChat AI: The Most Detailed Experience Across the Web, I Fell in Love with Browsing Moments Again
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides an in-depth experience of WeChat's native AI assistant 'XiaoWei', detailing its ubiquitous entry points, core features (message sending, Moments summarization, group chat summarization, Mini Program invocation, AI image generation, etc.), and the product philosophy behind its WeLM model and connected ecosystem.

relatedArticles.title: Harness Engineering: How I Spent a Week Boosting AI Coding Rate to 90% in an Enterprise App
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically introduces Harness Engineering, a new AI coding paradigm that elevates the AI code rate of an enterprise Java application from 25% to over 90% by building a four-element system of rules, skills, knowledge, and change management.

relatedArticles.title: iPhone Finally Gets Siri AI! But Mainland China Misses Out on the First Release, Alarm Clock Becomes the Biggest Surprise
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: WWDC26 unveils iOS 27 and new Apple Intelligence developments, upgrading Siri to a system-level AI assistant with its own app, but users in mainland China will temporarily miss out on the AI features.

relatedArticles.title: AI R&D Automation: Wiki Knowledge Base + Skill Pack
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details how to build a continuously growing team knowledge base and a supporting expert skill pack based on the LLM-Wiki model and the Obsidian platform to achieve AI-driven R&D automation.

relatedArticles.title: Just Released: GPT-5.6 — Most Powerful Ever, Yet Self-Sabotaged
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article reports on the GPT-5.6 series launch, including details on three models (Sol/Terra/Luna), benchmark results, tiered safety measures, and US government review of access permissions, analyzing how frontier model releases are entering a new cycle shaped by national security concerns.

relatedArticles.title: DeepSeek-V4 Preview: Ushering in the Era of Million-Token Context for Everyone
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: DeepSeek releases the V4 preview, offering Pro and Flash versions with million-token context as standard, achieving open-source leadership in Agent, reasoning, and knowledge capabilities, and open-sourcing the model simultaneously.

relatedArticles.title: Dialogue with MiniMax's Zeyin: Agents Will Eventually Surpass Humans, Where Do We Go From Here?
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Through an in-depth conversation with Zeyin, a MiniMax Agent R&D engineer, this article reveals the design philosophy and technical details of the Agent Team architecture, as well as the industry consensus and trend shifting from model competition to scaffolding competition in Agent engineering.

relatedArticles.title: Kimi K2.6 Released and Open-Sourced, Significantly Advancing Code and Agent Cluster Capabilities
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Moonshot AI has released and open-sourced the Kimi K2.6 model, achieving significant improvements in code capabilities, long-horizon task execution, and Agent cluster collaboration, and announced the start of the Claw Group internal beta.
